subject: Kickoff: initial MAP draft — please validate owners, dependencies & timeline options
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lewis <emma@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: initial MAP draft — please validate owners, dependencies & timeline options

Hi Emma — thanks again for the discovery earlier today. I captured the commitments we discussed into an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) and sketched two timeline options so your team can pick what feels realistic.

High-level:
- Target scope: production-ready Redwood API integration for inference + monitoring & alerting hooks.
- Milestones in the draft: integration POC, security review, pilot run, SLA sign-off, contract execution.
- Owners: I populated primary Redwood owners and proposed ClearSight owners based on our call; please correct any mismatches.

Attachments: ClearSight_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), discovery-notes.pdf (call notes + open questions).

Ask for you: please confirm 1) the ClearSight owner for each milestone, 2) which timeline option you prefer (Conservative: 10–12 weeks vs Accelerated: 6–8 weeks), and 3) any dependencies we missed (e.g., procurement timing, security POA).

For context I'm cc'ing Karthik (solutions lead) and Marissa (CS lead) so we can align on the pilot success criteria and support windows. If it's helpful, I can schedule a 30-min kickoff next week to walk through the MAP live and lock owners.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

– Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: ClearSight_MAP_v1.xlsx (24KB) — MAP draft
 Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (48KB) — discovery notes and open questions]
From: Emma Lewis <emma@clearsight.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearsight.ai
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: initial MAP draft — please validate owners, dependencies & timeline options

Vanessa — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear draft. I reviewed the spreadsheet with our engineering and procurement leads. A few notes inline: 

- Owners: please update the milestones to:
  • POC owner: Ethan Wu (Eng) — ethan.wu@clearsight.ai
  • Security review: Priya Desai (InfoSec) — priya.desai@clearsight.ai
  • Procurement/Contract: procurement@clearsight.ai (we loop legal once pricing is vetted)

- Timeline: Accelerated looks attractive but our security window is the gating item. Realistically we should plan for Conservative unless Redwood can commit to a prioritized security questionnaire turnaround (3 business days).

- Dependencies:
  1) Access to a staging dataset (anonymized) — I noted that under 'customer deliverables'.
  2) Clarify data retention and logging — Priya will send the current policy to you.
  3) Procurement cadence — we run monthly contract cycles; if Redwood can be on the November package we can shorten legal review time.

Can we schedule the live kickoff for Tue 11/10 10:00 PT? If Marissa or Karthik prefer a different time we're flexible that morning.

On the questionnaire, I'll start the security thread and put Priya on cc once I have the initial doc.

Best,
Emma
VP, Platform Partnerships — ClearSight Health
emma@clearsight.ai | +1 617-555-0310

Subject: RE: Kickoff: initial MAP draft — please validate owners, dependencies & timeline options

Folks — quick internal note after reading Emma's reply:

- Add a discrete milestone for 'Legal redlines / pricing approval' with owner = Redwood Sales Ops (Rishi) and ClearSight owner = procurement@clearsight.ai. That will make the contract path visible in the MAP rather than buried in 'Contract execution'.

- Add a 'Security deep-dive (scoped)' milestone to cover the 3-business-day turnaround Emma asked for — owner = Redwood Security (I'll flag this with Rishi to coordinate). We should include an SLA placeholder so ClearSight knows the expected response time.

- Pilot readiness: we should list 'staging dataset delivered' as a blocking dependency under the POC milestone. Emma already flagged this which is good.

I'll drop a quick column in the spreadsheet for 'blocking? yes/no' and 'expected lead time'. Vanessa — if you want I can jump on the kickoff to cover the security scope and SLA ask.

-Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lewis <emma@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, procurement@clearsight.ai

Subject: Re: Kickoff: initial MAP draft — please validate owners, dependencies & timeline options

Emma — thanks for the quick review and the owner list. I updated the MAP (attached v1.1) with the changes Karthik suggested and added the two timeline options as separate sheets so it's easier to compare lead times. Summary of updates: 

- Owners updated per your note (Ethan, Priya, procurement).
- New milestones added: 'Legal redlines / pricing approval' (owner: Rishi) and 'Security deep-dive (SLA: 3 business days target)' (owner: Redwood Security, contact: rishi@redwood.com for coordination).
- Dependency column added and the staging dataset marked as blocking for POC start.
- Proposed target close window: Option A (Conservative) — target close by 2027-01-08; Option B (Accelerated) — target close by 2026-12-15 (requires security SLA + procurement in November cycle).

Next steps: please confirm 1) that the named ClearSight owners are correct, 2) whether the procurement team can aim for the November cycle (procurement@clearsight.ai), and 3) if Tue 11/10 10:00 PT still works for a 30-min kickoff to walk through the plan. If we lock the timeline and owners post-kickoff, I'll convert the MAP to a shared Drive doc and add version tracking.

Thanks all — attaching updated files.

– Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
